subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Should this issue be fixed by OpenRouter-specific Anthropic tool-argument streaming, a timeout policy change, or a broader large tool-payload strategy?
rationale: The source supports the bug report but the possible fixes have different provider-boundary, latency, and compatibility tradeoffs that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Provider-specific streaming
options.body: Add or reuse a supported OpenRouter/Anthropic tool-argument streaming path and prove it with the reported large Write-tool scenario.

options.title: Timeout policy change
options.body: Increase or document the relevant default/explicit timeouts, accepting slower detection of real provider stalls.

options.title: Broader payload design
options.body: Track this under a general large tool-payload strategy such as chunked writes or streamed/file-backed tool arguments.

recommendation.title: Provider-specific streaming
recommendation.body: Add or reuse a supported OpenRouter/Anthropic tool-argument streaming path and prove it with the reported large Write-tool scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-stream and Anthropic/OpenRouter-adjacent history makes this the strongest available owner signal for choosing the provider-boundary fix shape.
